tasks.title: Conversation #111
tasks.transcript:
Man: Have you decided on a venue for your wedding reception?
Woman: Yes, we're going to have it at the Riverside Pavilion. It has a beautiful view of the river.
Man: That sounds lovely. Are you planning to have live music?
Woman: Yes. We've booked a local band to play during the reception.
Man: Great choice. It's going to be a wonderful event.

questions.stem: Where will a wedding reception be held?
questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：婚礼招待会将在哪里举行？ 定位原文：Woman: Yes, we‘re going to have it at the Riverside Pavilion. It has a beautiful view of the river. 选项分析： A. At a hotel 在酒店。对话中未提及酒店，所以A选项错误。 B. At a restaurant 在餐厅。对话中未提及餐厅，所以B选项错误。 C. By a river 在河边。女士明确说地点是“Riverside Pavilion”（河滨亭），并且能看到河景，所以C选项正确。 D. In a garden 在花园里。对话中未提及花园，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What kind of entertainment will be at the reception?
questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：招待会上将有什么样的娱乐活动？ 定位原文：Woman: Yes. We’ve booked a local band to play during the reception. 选项分析： A. A DJ 一名DJ。对话中未提及DJ，所以A选项错误。 B. A local band 一支本地乐队。女士明确说预定了一支本地乐队在招待会上演奏，所以B选项正确。 C. A magician 一名魔术师。对话中未提及魔术师，所以C选项错误。 D. A dance troupe 一个舞团。对话中未提及舞蹈团，所以D选项错误。
